note: 0x06b1 and 0x282c are string-table lookups of the same numbers as the page-27 image ids. Kind 12 does not use this table.

strings.0x127a:
Set the focus position when
a specified subject is detected. 
Settings can be configured
separately for
the shutter button and @A049@ button.
strings.0x127c:
When a specified subject is detected at
the selected AF target position, AF is
performed on the detected subject.
strings.0x127d:
AF is always performed at
the selected AF target position.
strings.0x124e:
When a face or eye is detected,
the AF position is set to
the detected face or eye.
strings.0x1250:
When a face or eye is detected,
the AF position is set to
the selected AF target.
